about: Measured first downward triangle intersection from the actual road slab bottom; all TITAN evaluated meshes, FIT excluded. Distances follow the road up axis, not global height. Misses are not counted as seated. Surface coordinates/normals are Blender world axes.

method.limitation: Finite road and cross-width stations, not a continuous mathematical proof. Clearance is checked separately. A ray that starts below an intruding surface can hit a deeper surface; this report never substitutes for strict clearance.

stretches.note: climbs over the fingertips and the open palm, rising to the wrist
stretches.interpretation: Leading rays without any TITAN hit identify the approach before the fingertips. Partial-width misses remain separately visible; they are not excused as approach.

stretches.note: along the top of the forearm, palm up
climbs off the upper arm, over the top of the right shoulder armour and onto the chest (over the upper arm it rises clear of it: pylons stand on the arm there)
stretches.interpretation: The brief explicitly retains the climb above the upper arm with game-side pylons. Large gaps whose hit part is upper_arm.R are reported unchanged, rather than called seated.

stretches.note: north along the top of the chest by the collarbone
turns west off the chest onto the chin
over the face and forehead, down the middle, between the horns: the head tipped forward on its broken neck and propped up (pose.json head)
